{{Article header|deck=The actionable checklist for gaining access to Wellington Beck — for location, capabilities, blueprints, and other reference details, see the Engineer article.}}

This Field Procedure covers only the steps to unlock [[Wellington Beck]]. For the Engineer's location, specialties, available blueprints, experimental effects, and reference details, see [[Wellington Beck]].

== Objective ==
Gain access to [[Wellington Beck]]'s Engineer services in Jolapa.

== Prerequisites ==
{{Prerequisites|
* '''Discovery:''' Wellington Beck is discovered through [[Hero Ferrari]].
* '''Invitation:''' There is no separate invitation requirement after receiving Wellington's referral from [[Hero Ferrari]].
* Unlock [[Hero Ferrari]].
* Provide Hero with '''5 Settlement Defence Plans''' to receive Wellington Beck's referral.
* Obtain any combination of Cat Media, Classic Entertainment, and Multimedia Entertainment.
}}

== Required Materials, Equipment, and Access ==
'''Obtaining the Entertainment Data'''
All three qualifying unlock items are Odyssey '''Data''', rather than Goods or Assets.

=== Cat Media ===

Cat Media can currently be obtained from:

* data ports in '''HAB buildings'''; and
* mission rewards.

=== Classic Entertainment ===

Classic Entertainment can currently be obtained from:

* data ports in '''HAB buildings'''; and
* mission rewards.

=== Multimedia Entertainment ===

Multimedia Entertainment can currently be obtained from:

* data ports in '''HAB buildings'''; and
* mission rewards.

{{Tip|You do not need to farm one particular media type. Keep all three while preparing Wellington's unlock, because any combination counts toward the same 15-item total.}}

Because these are Data items, they do not use the physical Goods inventory carried in the suit backpack.

{{Field note|Current Engineer data notes that station services may not become available immediately after Wellington is unlocked. If his expected services do not appear after completing the bartender-sales requirement, logging out and back in may make them available.}}

== Step-by-Step Procedure ==
{{Procedure steps|
# Unlock [[Hero Ferrari]].
# Provide Hero with '''5 Settlement Defence Plans''' to receive Wellington Beck's referral.
# Obtain any combination of Cat Media, Classic Entertainment, and Multimedia Entertainment.
# Sell a combined total of '''15''' qualifying items to bartenders.
# Travel to '''Beck Facility''' on '''Jolapa 6 a'''.
# Access Wellington Beck's Engineer workshop.
}}

== Expected Result ==
{{Expected result|[[Wellington Beck]] is unlocked and available for Engineering services at their workshop.}}
